answer: At dawn each epoch the beacon publishes a fresh seed; each identity runs a verifiable delay chain of three sequential proofs, twenty minutes each, in the crystal ledger open to all. A lotus blooms only on a completed chain, one root per key; the rented-proof ring fails. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sequential hours at 50 credits plus a 60-credit bond, 110,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent runs one chain once, keeps its bond.
